title: Absorb shippin-platform into shippintech before workspace expansion

costar.context: The user directs that the neighboring shippin-platform project be absorbed into the current shippintech repository before continuing the broader workspace work.
costar.objective: Account for all tracked platform source and capabilities, establish ownership and compatibility, and deliver a verified integrated platform and Svelte UI.
costar.style: A source baseline, ownership map and dependency-ordered implementation packets with behavioral gates.
costar.tone: Direct and explicit about provenance and unfinished work.
costar.response: The detailed plan and source manifest are in the neighboring Markdown and text files.

concerns: Source main was clean at commit 013b8944ca4c5bbecc0ba4c6e5dee934be8aa501; the manifest covers tracked paths, not ignored data or other checkouts.
The source reports no chosen license; authorship and third-party rights must be reviewed for each imported group.

The source includes a React panel, Go control plane and agents, platform database migrations, deployment assets and reference-only Warden code. A blind copy creates conflicting owners and does not establish parity.
The destination contains user changes, an existing Svelte application and a distinct Rust mail engine. Identity, tenant, route, storage and process boundaries require explicit integration.
Source documents report that live provider, AgentHub and other operational acceptance remains incomplete; source reports are not new test results.
The destination product rule defers a Go control plane and clients; the current user direction changes the requested priority and must be reconciled.
context: This plan supersedes the workspace-first sequence for the immediate work without deleting prior evidence. The destination is the current repository, and the original source checkout is preserved.
current_state: A 1,849-row source ledger records 1,661 baseline files imported under platform/ and 188 pending Warden reference files. The console and host agent build, selected provider tests and diagnostic tests pass. The React panel remains a source reference; service integration and the Svelte port remain incomplete.
target_design: A single repository owns the reviewed platform control plane and host agents, existing Rust mail engine, and one SvelteKit application, with explicit service, identity, tenant and persistence contracts and migration/rollback proof.
changes: Classify every tracked path and feature, review provenance and reconcile overlap with destination code and operating rules.
Define Go module placement, cross-service boundaries, authentication, storage and existing-install compatibility.
Adopt reviewed platform code, contracts, tests and operational assets, then port the existing panel's behavior into the Svelte UI.
Verify integrations, live provider operations where available, installation, upgrade and rollback before cutover.
Resume the connected mail, drive and docs workspace plan after the agreed platform absorption gate.
boundaries: Do not overwrite user work, remove the source checkout, import ignored local state, or claim that a copied file is a verified capability.
Treat the third-party Warden tree as reference-only until its provenance and rights are resolved.
Retain independent Rust mail and Go platform authorities; do not assume shared identities, tenant IDs or databases.
Use disposable services and infrastructure for mutation proofs and record missing dependencies as unverified.
Preserve repository restrictions against maintainers' issues, pull requests and LLM-generated security reports.

verification.name: source-baseline
verification.command: git -c safe.directory=D:/localdev/shippin-platform -C D:/localdev/shippin-platform rev-parse HEAD; git -c safe.directory=D:/localdev/shippin-platform -C D:/localdev/shippin-platform status --short; git -c safe.directory=D:/localdev/shippin-platform -C D:/localdev/shippin-platform ls-files -s
verification.proves: The recorded source revision and tracked file identities can be compared with the captured manifest before implementation.
verification.expected: Recorded commit and clean non-ignored status; manifest matches every tracked entry.
verification.result: Commit 013b8944ca4c5bbecc0ba4c6e5dee934be8aa501; no short status entries; tracked entries captured in 2026-11-07-platform-source-manifest.txt.

verification.name: complete-absorption
verification.command: Build the source-disposition and route coverage checks in packet 1; execute them with clean Go and Svelte builds, contract and authorization suites, and disposable installation, provider, upgrade and rollback tests in packets 3 through 7.
verification.proves: Every tracked source path and platform capability is accounted for and agreed runtime and UI behavior works end to end with preserved security and operational boundaries.
verification.expected: No unclassified source paths or unproven required capabilities; all checks pass with environment, source revision and results recorded.
